schemes.official_name: Parcours Civique (Civic Learning Programme), Collège universitaire
schemes.description: Compulsory two-year module of the Bachelor of Arts: a 140-hour civic internship after year 1, a 50-hour civic engagement project in year 2 (independent or group), and a Capstone reflective essay. Internship component is an individual placement; the project may be independent or group; no evidence that an external organisation sets a brief or receives a project output as a bounded team project.
schemes.eligible_faculties_programmes: BA students of the Collège universitaire
schemes.year_of_study: Years 1-2 (capstone submitted end of year 2, or year 3 for 2022-2025 cohort)
schemes.eligibility_restrictions: Compulsory module of the BA degree (Collège campuses)
schemes.credit_assessment: Minimum 6, maximum 9 ECTS for field experiences; Capstone 6 ECTS
schemes.duration: 140 h (summer after Y1) + 50 h project over Y2
schemes.delivery_format: Civic internship + civic project + reflective essay
schemes.project_evidence: A civic engagement project 'involving community service or the promotion of equality and inclusion' is required; brief and output not specified; the assessed output is an individual reflective essay [1].
schemes.group_evidence: Projects can be 'independent or group'; routes not separable [1].
schemes.employer_evidence: Page names no partner organisations and links to separate 'examples of field experiences'; role of host organisations in the project not shown [1].
schemes.unresolved: Whether any group civic projects have an external organisation as client; undated page; counts as a lead only.

schemes.official_name: Capstone Project, Master in Advanced Global Studies (MAGS), Paris School of International Affairs (PSIA)

schemes.employer_evidence: Host supplies project, background and context, a Host Advisor is main contact (meetings at least every 3 weeks per search extract), host representatives sit on the evaluation panel and receive the report/presentation [1].

profile_md: Sciences Po (Paris) has several partner-linked team project routes in its graduate schools; none could be verified as institution-wide compulsory. The clearest is the compulsory 12-ECTS MAGS Capstone at PSIA: groups of 3-5 act as consultants for host organisations (2025-26: ITU, OECD, IEA, UNDP, UNESCO, CMA CGM), with host representatives on the pass/fail panel. The Policy Lab public policy incubator (M1, 6 ECTS, teams of 4-6, partner-set challenges, jury of partners) and the Ecole urbaine collective projects (teams of 4-5, 5-9 months, written report and oral presentation to the commissioning organisation) are well described, but only 2026-27 calls were evidenced, so they are recorded as announced. Optional cooperative projects (Paris-campus master's, teams of 3-5, mainly associations/foundations) are open widely but the calendar is undated. The compulsory BA Civic Learning Programme is individual placement plus an independent-or-group project with no client role evidenced. Impact Studio projects have partner-set problems but no stated deliverable. Mostly postgraduate and school-based; no engineering or natural science provision. Pages were French or English; French extracts translated. Uncertain: compulsory status and ECTS of Ecole urbaine projects, 2025/26 delivery of the Policy Lab and Ecole urbaine routes, Law School clinic structure.
gaps: Further departmental projects likely (other PSIA masters, Law School clinic, Policy Lab Intensive). 2025/26 delivery for S3/S4 not opened. Fetch tool summarised pages (retrieval via WebFetch model summaries; quotes may be abridged). Reduced-depth mode: about 10 searches and 12 fetches.
